notes: Akamai returns HTTP 403 'Access Denied' to direct requests (python-requests and curl alike) and translate.goog is refused with HTTP 400, so every page was fetched through the r.jina.ai reader proxy, which returns Pepperfry's genuine server-rendered Angular HTML. Each listing page carries its own total twice: the visible header '1-40 of N options in <category>' and the embedded NEWCLIP JSON (data.total_product_count). Both agreed exactly on all 46 rows. The left-rail category facet (keys L1/L2) on those same pages carries per-category counts that matched the target page's own header wherever cross-checked, so the tree was walked from those facets. Rows are Pepperfry's own sub-categories of the Home Decor (cat 6), Lamps & Lighting (cat 101) and Kitchen & Dining (cat 6516) departments; they do not overlap each other. Where a sub-category mixed in-scope and out-of-scope goods (Spiritual = idols + mandir furniture; Table Decor = decor + desk organisers) its qualifying children were taken instead of the parent. Excluded per brief: all Furniture and Mattresses, Furnishings/textiles, Clocks (2139), Home Utility, Screens & Dividers, Wall Shelves & Cabinets, Gardening, Kids Decor, Fridge Magnets, Set Top Box Holders, Appliances, Prayer Essentials/Mandir (pooja consumables and utensils), Cookware, Bakeware, Cooking Tools, Knives & Cutlery, Kitchen Organizers, Lunch Boxes, Table/Kitchen Linen, Bulbs, Emergency Lights, Kids Lamps, and every sale/marketing node (Republic Day Sale, Home Flash Sale, Black Friday Sale, Exclusive Deals, Decor Finds, Kitchen Finds, Gifting, Decor Gift Sets, Lighting Clearance Sale). Also excluded are Pepperfry's merged duplicate nodes in the 7175-7190 id range (Wall Art and Decor, Table Decor and Accents, Drinkware and Barware, Dinnerware and Serveware, etc.), which re-list products already counted under their component categories.
